release_notes: Fix: the Exercise Details hourly step chart showed the same step count in almost every bar. Health Connect's own per-hour lookup was re-splitting one coarse all-day record evenly across each hour it was asked about; it now reads the raw step records directly, grouped by when they actually happened.

Fix: Active calories and Distance now also check today's recorded exercise/workout sessions as a source, not just continuous all-day records — some phones (Samsung Health included) only forward those two into Health Connect as part of a workout, never as a running total through an ordinary day.

New: the Exercise Details card now labels a Distance/Active kcal number as "estimated from steps" or "not synced" whenever it isn't a real Health Connect reading, instead of looking identical to real data.
The Health Connect Setup screen now also checks Exercise sessions, and explains the workout-fallback path when Active calories/Distance still show no standalone data.
